reply.text:
Cutting weight in 3 days means water cutting, crash dieting or both, and that's not something I'll coach. It's one to take to a doctor or a registered dietitian who works with combat athletes, since the risks are real and the right call depends on you. If you're close to the limit, they can tell you what is and isn't safe.

What I can help with is the training side. I can set up a light, sharp session or two before the tournament so you arrive fresh, and plan your week around recovery afterward. Want me to build one?
